name: CloudBeaver
description: CloudBeaver is a web-based database GUI tool which provides rich web interface. You can use it to manage PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, Firebird, H2, Trino.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  cloudbeaver:
    container_name: cloudbeaver
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
    image: dbeaver/cloudbeaver:26.0.5
    ports:
      - target: 8978
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/workspace
        target: /opt/cloudbeaver/workspace
    network_mode: bridge
    privileged: false
